sloka: त्यक्तधर्मव्रतं क्रूरं नृशंसमनृतं तथा ।नाहमर्हो ऽस्मि संस्कर्तुं परदाराभिमर्शिनम् ।। ६.११४.९४ ।।
transliteration: tyaktadharmavrataṁ krūraṁ nṛśaṁsamanṛtaṁ tathā ।nāhamarho 'smi saṁskartuṁ paradārābhimarśinam ।। 6.114.94 ।।

translations.english: Then the wise and righteous Vibheeshana thinking made a wholesome and righteous submission in the following words.
